question.text: The MINIMUM net worth requirement for a Portfolio Manager under SEBI PM Regs 2020 is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI PM Regs: Rs. 5 crore continuous net worth (up from Rs. 2 cr pre-2020). The Trap: Rs. 2 cr is outdated; Rs. 10 cr is AMC-level. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A; XXI-B deeper. Manager's Pro-Tip: Demonstrate net worth quarterly via CA-certified statement.
